subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who avoids sensory pleasures and physical comforts
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ascetic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ascetic"** refers to a person who practices severe self-discipline and abstention from all forms of indulgence, typically for religious reasons. (संयमी)

 
 
• **Example: **The monk led an **ascetic **life, devoid of any luxury or comfort.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct one word substitute is Ascetic.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Frugal** (मितव्ययी): Sparing or economical with regard to money or food.

 
 
• **Example:** He was known for his **frugal **lifestyle, always saving money wherever possible.
 
 
 
• **Epicurean** (भोगवादी): A person who takes particular pleasure in fine food and drink.
 
 
• **Example:** She was an **epicurean **who enjoyed trying gourmet dishes from around the world.
 
 
 
• **Bohemian** (बोहेमियन): A person who has informal and unconventional social habits, especially an artist or writer.
 
 
• **Example:** He lived a **bohemian **lifestyle, traveling from city to city and creating art.
